name: AP_PAYMENT_KEY_IND_ALL
description: AP_PAYMENT_KEY_IND stores compiled payment information for the Key Indicators Report.  There is one row for each period for which you report on payment key indicators.  The information in this table is denormalized for reporting purposes.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Name of the key indicator calendar period.

columns.name: CALENDAR_NAME
columns.description: Name of the calendar for the selected period.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: NUM_AUTO_PAYMENTS
columns.description: Number of invoices paid by automatic payments

columns.name: NUM_MANUAL_PAYMENTS
columns.description: Number of invoices paid by manual payments

columns.name: AMOUNT_AUTO_PAYMENTS
columns.description: Amount of invoices paid by automatic payments

columns.name: AMOUNT_MANUAL_PAYMENTS
columns.description: Amount of invoices paid by manual payments

columns.name: NUM_INVOICES_PAID
columns.description: Number of invoices paid in the calendar period.

columns.name: NUM_AUTO_CHECKS
columns.description: Number of automatic payments printed

columns.name: NUM_MANUAL_CHECKS
columns.description: Number of manual checks entered

columns.name: AMOUNT_AUTO_CHECKS
columns.description: Amount of automatic payments printed

columns.name: AMOUNT_MANUAL_CHECKS

columns.name: NUM_DISCOUNTS_TAKEN

columns.name: AMOUNT_DISCOUNTS_TAKEN

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
